title: Brownie Red Velvet
creator: andressaschuchh

items.note: add a little at a time until you like the colour

steps: Cream cheese layer: mix the cream cheese, sugar and egg just until combined. Set aside.
Melt the dark chocolate with the butter.
In another bowl, beat the egg with the sugar until pale and airy.
Combine the chocolate mixture with the egg mixture.
Add the flour, cocoa, salt and red food colouring and fold in gently.
Fold in the white chocolate pieces.
Pour into a parchment-lined pan, keeping a little batter aside for the top.
Spread the cream cheese layer over the brownie, then dot the reserved batter on top and swirl to decorate.
Bake in a preheated oven at 180 °C for about 35 minutes, until the top is set but not dark.
Cool at room temperature, then chill in the fridge before serving.
